content.short: Clober is a fully on-chain order book protocol that enables high-performance spot trading on EVM networks.
content.description: Clober is a sophisticated decentralized exchange protocol that brings the efficiency and precision of a central limit order book (CLOB) entirely on-chain. Unlike traditional AMMs, Clober allows users to place limit orders and execute trades with zero slippage, providing a professional trading experience that is fully transparent and non-custodial. The protocol's architecture is optimized for low gas consumption and high throughput, making it a powerful foundation for building advanced financial applications on EVM-compatible networks. By prioritizing capital efficiency and deep liquidity, Clober aims to revolutionize decentralized spot trading, offering retail and institutional users a superior alternative to centralized exchanges.
content.meta: Clober provides a high-performance, fully on-chain order book for decentralized spot trading with zero slippage and professional-grade tools.
